comment: The geolocation commands are listed one by one because that plugin ships no default set:
`geolocation:default` exists, so it passes build-time validation, but it grants nothing and
every call is refused at runtime.
Only these three. `watch-position` and `clear-watch` are deliberately absent - the daylight
curve needs one fix per session and a tripod does not move, so a continuous location
subscription would be asking for more than the feature uses.
